proof_body:
by
  intro V _ _ _ q
  refine ⟨QuadraticForm.equivalent_one_zero_neg_one_weighted_sum_squared q, fun u t hu ht => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · rw [← QuadraticForm.sigPos_of_equiv_weightedSumSquares hu, ← QuadraticForm.sigPos_of_equiv_weightedSumSquares ht]
  · rw [← QuadraticForm.sigNeg_of_equiv_weightedSumSquares hu, ← QuadraticForm.sigNeg_of_equiv_weightedSumSquares ht]
target_source: ∀ (V : Type*) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V] [FiniteDimensional ℝ V] (q : QuadraticForm ℝ V), (∃ w : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ V) → ℝ, (∀ i, w i = -1 ∨ w i = 0 ∨ w i = 1) ∧ QuadraticMap.Equivalent q (QuadraticMap.weightedSumSquares ℝ w)) ∧ ∀ u t : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ V) → ℝ, QuadraticMap.Equivalent q (QuadraticMap.weightedSumSquares ℝ u) → QuadraticMap.Equivalent q (QuadraticMap.weightedSumSquares ℝ t) → {i | 0 < u i}.ncard = {i | 0 < t i}.ncard ∧ {i | u i < 0}.ncard = {i | t i < 0}.ncard
